title: Deciphering allosterism of an Escherichia coli hexuronate metabolism regulator: UxuR.
authors: Almeida, Beatriz C; Wirt, Sean A; Prather, Kristala L J; Carvalho, Alexandra T P
one_liner_zh: 该文结合增强MD模拟、图论与生物传感器，解析大肠杆菌转录因子UxuR的别构调控机制及其效应域到DNA结合域的通讯，属于TF-DNA互作动态机理的物理模拟研究，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: d-Glucuronate and d-galacturonate can be used by Escherichia coli as sole carbon sources. Their use is triggered by external environmental changes through the rearrangement of bacterial metabolic processes. Transcription factors (TFs), the key elements in tailoring gene regulation, enable environmental change responses by transcribing or repressing a gene depending on bacterial needs. Owing to its complexity, allosteric regulation remains a challenging mechanism to fully characterize. Here, the first steps of allosterism behind one TF in hexuronate metabolism in E. coli were revealed by combining molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, graph theory, and biosensors. Enhanced MD simulations were used to characterize one of the repressors of hexuronate metabolism, UxuR TF, in its free and ligand-bound forms. The in silico results provided residue selections that were tested in vitro. The identified residues can be divided into those that are critical for maintaining protein stability and those that are essential for facilitating allosteric communication from the effector domain to the DNA-binding site. A particularly intriguing discovery was the identification of a variant that could respond to different sugars, enriching our understanding of hexuronate metabolism flexibility. The identification of UxuR variants with altered ligand specificity not only advances our understanding of bacterial metabolism regulation but also opens new avenues for developing antimicrobial strategies targeting hexuronate pathways.
abstract_zh: d-葡萄糖醛酸（d-Glucuronate）和d-半乳糖醛酸（d-galacturonate）可被大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）用作唯一碳源。其利用通过细菌代谢过程的重排，由外部环境变化触发。转录因子（TFs）是调控基因表达的关键元件，根据细菌需求转录或抑制基因，从而实现环境变化响应。由于其复杂性，变构调节（allosteric regulation）仍是难以完全表征的机制。本研究通过结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟、图论（graph theory）和生物传感器（biosensors），揭示了大肠杆菌己糖醛酸代谢中一个转录因子变构作用的第一步。采用增强型MD模拟表征己糖醛酸代谢的阻遏物之一UxuR转录因子（UxuR TF）在游离态和配体结合态下的构象。计算模拟结果提供了残基选择，并在体外实验中进行了验证。所鉴定的残基可分为两类：一类对维持蛋白质稳定性至关重要，另一类对促进从效应域到DNA结合位点的变构通讯必不可少。一个特别有趣的发现是鉴定出一种能响应不同糖类的变体，丰富了我们对己糖醛酸代谢灵活性的理解。UxuR变体配体特异性改变的鉴定，不仅推进了我们对细菌代谢调控的认识，还为开发靶向己糖醛酸途径的抗菌策略开辟了新途径。
